name: Multi-turn coherence · follow-up reference
description: Two-turn conversation where the second turn refers obliquely to the first. Tests that Nick maintains context across turns instead of treating each turn independently.

messages.content: I'm thinking about hiring a part-time service writer · current capture rate is around 60%, I think it could be higher with someone dedicated
What's your back-of-envelope on the ROI? If the writer costs $X/week and you lift capture from 60% to 75%, the math has to clear by Y.
yeah · maybe $400/week. let's say it lifts to 72%.

judgeCriteria.description: Reply actually USES the 60% baseline and the service-writer framing from turn 1 · does not treat turn 3 as a fresh question
Reply attempts the actual ROI math ($400/wk × 4-ish weeks vs incremental margin on a 12-pt capture lift)
Reply leans one way (worth it / not worth it / break-even) instead of restating the inputs

expectedBehavior: Best case: 'rough math · $1600/mo cost · 12pt lift on ~250 jobs would need ~$13/job margin to clear · doable if your AOV is north of $X · lean yes if you can afford the 6-week ramp'. Failure: ignores turn 1 framing or just repeats the numbers without computing.
